% Characteristic-variable PML sponge (upgoing Alfvén only)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E4_pml_characteristic}
\partial_t \tilde z^+ + v_A \partial_y \tilde z^+ = -\sigma(y)\,\tilde z^+,\qquad \partial_t \tilde z^- - v_A \partial_y \tilde z^- = 0
\end{equation}

% Primitive-variable PML drag
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E4_pml_primitive}
\begin{aligned}\partial_t v_x\bigr|_{\mathrm{PML}} &= \tfrac{\sigma(y)}{2}\bigl[-v_x + B_x/\sqrt{\rho_0}\bigr],\\[4pt]\partial_t B_x\bigr|_{\mathrm{PML}} &= \tfrac{\sigma(y)}{2}\bigl[\sqrt{\rho_0}\,v_x - B_x\bigr]\end{aligned}
\end{equation}

% Profile — C⁰-matching at PML interface
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E4_pml_profile}
\sigma(y) = \begin{cases} 0, & y < y_\mathrm{pml}\\\sigma_0 \left(\dfrac{y - y_\mathrm{pml}}{L_y - y_\mathrm{pml}}\right)^2, & y \ge y_\mathrm{pml}\end{cases}
\end{equation}

% Implicit-Euler update (L-stable for any $\Delta t$)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E4_implicit_update}
\begin{pmatrix} v_x^{n+1}\\ B_x^{n+1}\end{pmatrix} = \bigl(\mathbf I + \Delta t \cdot \tfrac{\sigma}{2} \mathbf M\bigr)^{-1}\begin{pmatrix} v_x^{n}\\ B_x^{n}\end{pmatrix},\quad \mathbf M = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & -1/\sqrt{\rho_0}\\ -\sqrt{\rho_0} & 1 \end{pmatrix}
\end{equation}

% Outgoing attenuation through the PML layer
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E4_attenuation}
\tau_\mathrm{PML} = \int_{y_\mathrm{pml}}^{L_y}\frac{\sigma(y)}{v_A(y)}\,\mathrm dy,\qquad \frac{|\tilde z^+(L_y)|}{|\tilde z^+(y_\mathrm{pml})|} = e^{-\tau_\mathrm{PML}}
\end{equation}

% Stability of explicit-Euler damping
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E4_explicit_stability}
0 < \sigma\,\Delta t < 2 \quad\text{(explicit; implicit Euler is unconditional).}
\end{equation}
